summary: Case case-001 involves d.yilmaz@aegean.edu. Risk Gate verdict: contain (confidence 0.75) based on confirmed post-auth abuse and access signals. F2 confirms 38 SIS events from 185.220.101.7 within 60 min (T1213). F1 confirms a phishing email from aegean-edu.co with subject 'Acil hesap doğrulaması' (T1566.002). F5 confirms an API-created inbox forwarding rule to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (T1114.003). F3 confirms impossible travel Amsterdam → Manisa in 234 min (T1078.004). Password spray claim rejected due to shared-NAT background noise.

actions.action: Reset password and revoke all active sessions/tokens for d.yilmaz@aegean.edu; review sign-in history for unauthorized access.
Delete the inbox forwarding rule to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com and audit all mailbox rules, delegation, and send-as permissions.
Block 185.220.101.7 at perimeter controls and pull SIS access logs to determine which student records were viewed or exported.
Quarantine the phishing email from aegean-edu.co, search for additional delivered copies, and issue a user awareness alert.
Collect endpoint and EDR telemetry for the user's devices to check for malware, persistence, or lateral movement.

risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: phishing email from look-alike domain aegean-edu.co (F1, T1566.002) delivered initial access; impossible travel Amsterdam→Manisa (F3, T1078.004) indicates remote access from inconsistent locations; API-created inbox forwarding rule to external d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (F5, T1114.003) establishes persistence/exfiltration; and 38 bulk SIS events within 60 min from 185.220.101.7 (F2, T1213) shows data access after compromise. These four confirmed findings form a coherent end-to-end takeover chain. The rejected password-spray claim is explained away as shared-NAT background noise and does not conflict with the verified evidence. No data-quality conflicts. Contain is warranted.
